name: Heat
source:
An unassuming and somewhat forgettable young man.

Despite lacking any talent with magic or skills, he hopes to make a name for himself as an adventurer through innovative combat techniques, and dreams of one day having many wives.

[spoiler]He is actually a granddaughter of Enrai, who ran away from home in order to avoid having to wear the stealthy dress. [/spoiler]
